description:
Estamos em busca de um profissional dinâmico e motivado para integrar nossa equipe comercial. Se você é apaixonado por desafios, tem atitude de dono e busca uma carreira de sucesso, essa oportunidade é para você!

Responsabilidades:

  • Visitar entre 8 a 12 Farmácias de pequeno e médio porte da região;
  • Planejar e identificar as oportunidades de vendas, verificar, executar MPDV, dentro das rotinas do PEX (Programa de Excelência) na base de PDVs;
  • Atingir as metas de vendas estabelecidas;
  • Participar das reuniões diárias – matinal e fechamento de vendas on-line, de segunda à sexta.
  • Participar de treinamentos e eventos para atualização e desenvolvimento profissional;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de negociação;
  • Capacidade analítica verificar e atuar nas oportunidades;
  • Disciplina para cumprimento de rotina;
  • Disposição para trabalhos externos e viagens estaduais;
  • Carteira de motorista B;
  • Experiência Comercial Bens de consumo, Bebidas, Sorvete, Canal conveniência, setor de Adquirência (desejável);
  • Proatividade, atitude de dono e foco em resultados;
  • Desejável: Cursando Ensino Superior (Cursos prioritários: Engenharias, Economia, Física, Estatísticas, Matemática, Adm,)
  • Residir em Guarapari/ES.

Motivos para trabalhar na Legrand:

  • A Legrand oferece uma carreira acelerada com oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento real, em uma cultura de crescimento e meritocracia;

A Legrand hoje:

  • Empresa com mais de 100 SKUs, sendo 25 produtos líderes ou vice-líderes de mercado;
  • Faturamento anual superior a R$1 bilhão, com destaque para o produto Expec, que gera R$300 milhões por ano;

História recente:

  • Nos últimos três anos e meio, a Legrand dobrou de tamanho, aumentou seu market share e subiu duas posições no ranking, agora sendo a terceira maior;
  • Quintuplicou o número de colaboradores e foi certificada no ranking GTPW de melhores empresas para trabalhar nos últimos dois anos;
  • Novo lema “Viva a Vida”, focado em criar marcas amadas pelos consumidores.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!

With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.

Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!

Highlight Job of the Week!

Job Title: Sales Specialist

Pay Rate LinkedIn style:

Part-Time Monthly Rates: $1,000 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates: $2,000 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)

The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $12,5 - $16 depending on level of experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.

title: Repórter - Tribunais Superiores
description:
Sobre o Bastidor

Somos um veículo criado em 2020 por Diego Escosteguy com a missão de iluminar os segredos do poder. Nossa matéria-prima são notícias exclusivas e de alto impacto, seja por meio de informações sintéticas, seja por meio de reportagens profundas. Cobrimos assuntos e casos difíceis, que envolvem grandes personagens da vida política e econômica nacional. Praticamos jornalismo independente e apartidário com rigor profissional, mediante investigação crítica de fatos de interesse público.

Valorizamos trabalho em equipe, apuração constante junto a fontes humanas e uso avançado de ferramentas digitais e de IA para obtenção, checagem e análise de fontes documentais.

Sobre a vaga

Procuramos um repórter para cobrir, in loco, os tribunais superiores em Brasília, sobretudo Supremo Tribunal Federal e Superior Tribunal de Justiça. Experiência é desejável, mas não é o mais importante; buscamos talentos que tenham disposição para aprender e vontade de se tornar um grande repórter. Nossa cobertura de STF e STJ envolve tanto movimentos de bastidor e articulações por nomeações no Judiciário quanto acompanhamento de processos relevantes - sempre sob a supervisão de nossos editores.

Responsabilidades

  • Monitorar pautas (plenário/turmas), ler petições, votos, ementas e acórdãos.
  • Acompanhar liminares, pedidos de vista e movimentação processual (PJe, jurisprudência).
  • Mapear litigância estratégica de empresas, políticos e setores.
  • Construir e manter fontes (gabinetes, advocacia, PGR/AGU, academia, sociedade civil) com ética.
  • Produzir reportagens explicativas e investigativas com documentação sólida.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com editores e colegas para desenvolver pautas próprias e séries investigativas.
  • Usar ferramentas digitais/IA para triagem, verificação e organização de materiais.

Requisitos (obrigatórios)

  • Graduação em Jornalismo (concluída).
  • Domínio da Língua Portuguesa (clareza, lógica, gramática e edição).
  • Técnicas básicas de apuração; leitura cuidadosa de documentos jurídicos.
  • Conhecimento básico do funcionamento de STF e STJ (pautas, ritos, institutos).
  • Predisposição para construir e preservar fontes com ética e responsabilidade.
  • Independência e apartidarismo; julgamento editorial equilibrado.
  • Espírito crítico, curiosidade intelectual, trabalho em equipe e abertura a feedback.
  • Conforto com planilhas e pesquisa em bases públicas; disposição para aprender IA.

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

  • Formação/experiência em Direito ou cobertura de tribunais superiores.
  • Noções de pesquisa jurisprudencial e leitura de dados de litigância.
  • Inglês de leitura.

O que você aprenderá no Bastidor

  • Técnicas avançadas de reportagem e produção de exclusivas de alto impacto.
  • Pesquisa e obtenção de evidências jornalisticamente úteis (bases públicas e privadas).
  • Análise empírica e lógica de evidências e valoração criteriosa de fatos (epistemologia aplicada ao jornalismo).
  • Redação assertiva, equilibrada e clara, sem clichês, ilações ou hipérboles.
  • Uso avançado de IA e ML para organização, pesquisa e análise de casos.
  • Segurança operacional (física e digital) e proteção de fontes e documentos.

Como se candidatar

Envie seu currículo para com "Repórter Tribunais Superiores" e seu nome no campo de assunto. Inclua links para até três reportagens de sua autoria e um texto de até 300 palavras que descreva por que você quer trabalhar conosco.

title: Staff Software Engineer (Python) - Performance RE
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Se você gosta de aprender e quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. No dia a dia você vai:

  • Atuar como referência técnica do time, orientando decisões de arquitetura e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Desenvolver soluções ponta a ponta para aplicações escaláveis, resilientes e de alto throughput;
  • Participar de iniciativas de inovação e evolução da arquitetura, com foco em eficiência, performance e custo;
  • Apoiar tecnicamente outras pessoas engenheiras, promovendo aprendizado contínuo e excelência técnica;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em descobertas técnicas e de negócio;
  • Garantir qualidade, observabilidade e robustez em todo o ciclo de vida do software.

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência profunda com arquitetura de microserviços;
  • Atuação em backend Python e Node;
  • Sólido entendimento de arquitetura de software, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e sistemas em cloud platform (AWS);
  • Experiência com mensageria e arquitetura orientada a eventos com conhecimento em Kafka e AWS (SNS/SQS);
  • Vivência com sistemas em produção e a responsabilidade de operar e otimizar aplicações em escala;
  • Atenção rigorosa à qualidade e padronização do código, garantindo legibilidade, escalabilidade e performance. Isso inclui a implementação de rotinas de testes e documentação;
  • Conhecimento em práticas ágeis como Kanban, papeis, cerimônias e artefatos;
  • Habilidade para liderar discussões técnicas, promover alinhamento entre squads e tribos, conduzir soluções e promover boas decisões em escala de tribo;
  • Curiosidade para explorar e propor novos caminhos e soluções de tecnologias e processos, sempre buscando aprimorar a forma como o time trabalha.

Diferenciais que são um plus por aqui:

  • Experiência com Go e Java;
  • Flexibilidade para trabalhar com diferentes linguagens de programação.

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Benefícios:

  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado;

  • Previdência Privada;

  • Auxílio Home Office;
  • Auxílio Mobilidade;
  • Auxílio Criança;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Licenças estendidas;
  • Incentivo ao esporte, qualidade de vida e bem estar;

title: Analista de Custos Sênior
description:

title: UX/UI Designer Sênior - São Paulo/SP
description:

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma Product Designer responsável por projetar produtos com experiências intuitivas e envolventes, focando na solução de problemas de negócio por meio de princípios de design centrado no usuário. O objetivo é desenvolver soluções efetivas que ofereçam experiências únicas e personalizadas para nossos clientes, atendendo às necessidades específicas de cada segmento, desde a pesquisa inicial até a entrega de soluções visualmente atraentes e altamente funcionais.

Como será seu dia-a-dia?

Você será uma peça-chave em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto, com as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Diagnóstico: Identificar problemas e oportunidades analisando as dores dos usuários e as metas do negócio.
  • Pesquisa: Conduzir entrevistas, mapear jornadas e interpretar dados analíticos para guiar decisões.
  • Criação: Idear soluções criativas e muito significativas para as pessoas usuárias, trazendo experiências fluidas, lindas e, por que não, surpreendentes.
  • Prototipação e Design: Desenvolver fluxos, wireframes e interfaces impecáveis com componentes detalhados e organizados no Figma, garantindo adesão ao Design System e práticas de acessibilidade.
  • Validação: Realizar testes de usabilidade, aplicar testes A/B, validar a viabilidade técnica das soluções junto às equipes de engenharia e acompanhar métricas pós-lançamento para ajustar e aprimorar as entregas.
  • Colaboração: Atuar em uma equipe multidisciplinar, interna e externa, participando de rituais e tomadas de decisão, liderando projetos que promovam a interação entre designers e outros times, além de colaborar diretamente com equipes de engenharia para garantir a implementação eficaz das soluções.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Foco no usuário: Antecipar e atender às necessidades dos usuários dentro de um time de produto, garantindo soluções que agreguem valor e proporcionem boas experiências.
  • Comunicação e negociação: Colaborar com equipes de negócios e engenharia, traduzindo problemas complexos em soluções práticas e funcionais.
  • Tomada de decisão: Ter embasamento e agir com segurança e assertividade ao tomar decisões importantes.
  • Paixão pelo design: Interesse genuíno em participar de todas as etapas do processo de design, desde a concepção até a entrega.
  • Formação e ferramentas: Formação em Design, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas, com experiência sólida no uso de ferramentas como Figma, Adobe Illustrator e Photoshop.
  • Design System e acessibilidade: Domínio guias de estilo e práticas de acessibilidade, incluindo cores, contrastes e padrões de usabilidade.
  • Pesquisa e análise: Habilidade em conduzir pesquisas qualitativas e quantitativas de avaliação do produto, sempre transformando dados em insights estratégicos.
  • Apresentação de ideias: Capacidade de articular propostas e apresentar soluções baseadas em dados e insights do usuário.
  • Habilidade de antecipar problemas e adaptação a cenários imprevisíveis: A candidata/o deve ser proativa/o na identificação de desafios antecipados e capaz de se adaptar rapidamente a mudanças inesperadas, ajustando soluções para garantir a eficácia e alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Experiência prática no uso de Inteligência Artificial em seus processos criativos.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications

A SOMOS Educação é um dos principais grupos de educação básica do Brasil, oferecendo uma ampla variedade de soluções educacionais. Nossos serviços incluem sistemas de ensino, editoras, soluções de ensino complementares e uma plataforma tecnológica de aprendizado digital e e-commerce. Com isso, nos apresentamos como parceiros integrais das escolas.

Nossa missão é transformar o ecossistema das escolas privadas, combinando educação e gestão de alta qualidade com base na neurociência e na tecnologia em larga escala. Além disso, buscamos liderar as escolas no processo de transformação digital, visando ser o principal agente de reinvenção da educação para o aluno e a escola do século XXI.

Para cumprir essa missão e entregar o melhor para as nossas escolas, baseamos nosso trabalho em valores fundamentais. A Ausenco é uma empresa em rápido crescimento com grandes ideias. Redefinimos o que é possível em alguns dos projetos mais complexos e ambientes mais desafiadores do mundo. Fornecer consultoria inovadora e de valor agregado, entrega de projetos, operações de ativos e soluções de manutenção é o que fazemos.   • Apoiar na medição do projeto 3D.

Sobre você:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia;
  • Pós-graduação em Gestão de Projetos (desejável)
  • 10 anos de experiência mínima em função similar;
  • Conhecimento na indústria de mineração;
  • Nível avançado proficiente de inglês.

Por que Ausenco?

Apoiamos o crescimento individual e buscamos permitir que você trabalhe de uma forma que valorize seus pontos fortes e atenda às suas necessidades. Conheça nossa proposta de valor:

  • Remuneração e equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal – Além de um pacote de remuneração competitivo. Experimente o melhor dos dois mundos com nosso modelo de trabalho híbrido, que permite conciliar o trabalho presencial com o trabalho remoto. Aproveite os benefícios de políticas de licença modernas, incluindo licença parental remunerada, e comemore conosco feriados especiais.
  • Progressão na carreira - Receba apoio em seu desenvolvimento contínuo com treinamento técnico, programas de mentoria e oportunidades frequentes de networking.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar – Adote uma abordagem proativa para o seu bem-estar geral. Acesso a aconselhamento confidencial, serviços de saúde e um programa de benefícios que atende às suas necessidades.
  • Reconhecimento e Apreciação - Participe de espaços multidirecionais onde uma cultura de reconhecimento local e global é promovida, onde todos são reconhecidos por sua contribuição ao negócio e aos projetos.
  • Comunicação e comprometimento – Viva a experiência de trabalhar em uma empresa dinâmica com processos globais e trabalhe com líderes do setor de grande reputação que valorizam sua contribuição.

Nossos colaboradores não se contentam com o status quo. Se você tem espírito empreendedor e quer ajudar a estabelecer um novo padrão em sustentabilidade, nós o ajudaremos a encontrar o seu lugar. Isso significa trabalhar com você para desenvolver uma trajetória de carreira e um conjunto de habilidades únicos, que correspondam à sua ambição.

Temos orgulho do trabalho que fazemos e o fazemos dentro de uma cultura aberta, honesta e cooperativa. Temos um histórico de atrair pessoas visionárias que abraçam desafios e entregam soluções criativas para cada projeto, e a sua voz é uma parte importante da conversa.

Como uma empresa global, abraçamos e incentivamos a diversidade em seu sentido mais amplo – identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, experiência, nacionalidade, cor, idioma, religião, localização, deficiência, educação, habilidades, estilos de trabalho e disponibilidade de tempo. Nossos ambientes de trabalho são baseados na confiança mútua e no respeito pelos direitos e oportunidades de cada indivíduo.

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .

A RIGATTI® é uma clínica de transformação real. Somos referência em emagrecimento e equilíbrio hormonal com experiência de luxo, tratamentos personalizados e comunicação humanizada. Acreditamos no poder da mente, corpo e alma em equilíbrio e nosso conteúdo precisa refletir isso.

title: Sales Consultant
description:

Established 20 years ago, Phi Partners is a global technology services consultancy based out of London with an annualized turnover of £50m.

We operate exclusively within capital markets, in the front office, pricing and risk space, covering both business and technology services. With six lines of business, four international hubs and five international delivery centres, Phi has become a leading global financial markets IT services provider within our niche domains. We have over 500 consultants supporting more than 80 financial institutions around the world.

Our international sales team run out of Wrotham Business Park in London where we have over 30 sales consultants covering the broad range of business lines, clients and geographies. This team includes junior sales personnel who focus primarily on candidate research and recruitment whilst they are being trained to become client-facing sales consultants and eventually account managers. We are now expanding out Sales & Research team to include a team in our São Paulo office!

Phi offers our clients a comprehensive range of services including staff augmentation, advisory, project and managed services. These deals range from £100,000 to £20,000,000 in size, creating huge revenue and earnings opportunities.

Role and Career Opportunities

Phi has an ongoing commitment to growth in terms of client acquisition, geographical reach, and evolution of our lines of business and service catalogue. To support our ambitions, we take on four cohorts of junior sales consultants each year, in January, April, July, and October. Each consultant is trained the “Phi way”.

We are looking for talent who are either fresh out of university or in the early stages of their careers. Subject to meeting reasonable competency and performance targets, you can expect regular opportunities for advancement throughout your journey:

  • In the first 6 months you will be in our London Office being trained by our leadership team.
  • Initially, you will focus on candidate research and recruitment. After six months, you will be allocated to a line of business, allowing you to become a specialist recruiter within that field. Training that is specific to the line of business will allow you to master your ability to converse confidently with client and internal specialists.
  • After a period of between 12-18 months, you can expect to begin your move into client-facing sales. You will be allocated a small number of clients specific to your line of business, beginning your journey with client research, leading into full client engagement if the client is approved as a target.
  • Once you have closed deals with clients (bringing master services agreements between the client and Phi), you will begin to generate P&L. Subject to competency and revenue targets, you will complete your move into sales. We expect this phase to take between 18-24 months, and you will be supported on your journey by more senior sales leads, a deal architecture / pre-sales team, and the subject-matter-experts from within the delivery teams.
  • As a fully-fledged sales consultant, you will be part of a smaller group of 10, that are some of the best in the world. You will manage your client portfolio and may be given an expanded scope of clients giving you the room to really become a true success. Depending on results, you may be allocated one or two strategic key accounts, with the greatest potential for growth. These accounts are global, and relevant for multiple lines of business. They will bring a large portfolio, driving significant P&L and earnings.

Our most successful salespeople will make Partner at Phi, giving access to stock in the company that is granted annually based on a transparent assessment of contribution. Within the sales team we have three partners today, all of whom came through the graduate program, and we except two more to get promoted in 2025. The sky is the limit at Phi for the most ambitions and driven!

What we are looking for

Commitment and drive

We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a strong desire to succeed, and who are prepared to do “whatever it takes”. We are looking for problem solvers who have the ability to “find a way” to solve any challenge; people who won’t give up when the going gets tough! To become successful, it will take a long time to develop the required skills to be independent and to operate autonomously. So, we are looking for people who are truly committed and driven. These are all skills that you will have had life-long, applied and improved over many years. We will be looking to understand what drives you at a fundamental level, as this is what you will rely on to succeed.

Communication and charisma

Our sales consultants must be great communicators: people who have natural confidence with person-to-person communication, from over-the-phone interactions to directing meetings with senior stakeholders. You will need to be charismatic and confident. An ability to develop meaningful and relationships built on respect and trust is critical.

Team spirit

At Phi we have maintained a “small company” mindset and feel, with an excellent team spirit – we work together, we socialize together, we support each other. Our appreciation for the wider Phi community makes us stronger than the sum of our parts. We are looking for people who will naturally be at home as part of a strong team – who can understand our values, contribute to the wider Phi community, share knowledge, and put the team before themselves. We will be looking for evidence of this, academically, professionally, or outside (such as sport).

Life at Phi

Phi is an established business but feels like a start-up, specially being part of our brand-new team in Brazil. Your base will be in São Paulo, but as you develop into client-facing sales, you will spend time out of the office and will have opportunities for regular international travel.

Our family mentality means that even the most junior at Phi has access to the senior leadership team. We are approachable. You will be on first name terms with the CRO and CEO. Beyond the sales team, you will work within a wider community across pre-sales and delivery, specific to your clients and your line-of-business.

Our company thrives in having a diverse and international staff and this is especially true in our London office, where the Sales & Research team is located. Our sales consultants come from all parts of the world and there is a vibrant and youthful atmosphere. The atmosphere is dynamic and busy (punctual starts and hard work are inevitable), but always friendly. We socialize regularly outside office hours. Many of the senior team members at Phi have known each other for decades, and people who are the right fit for Phi can expect to build friendships that will last a lifetime. The goal is to build a similar environment in our new operation in Brazil!

Training and Reward

You can expect initial and ongoing training, in a well-designed, competency-based framework with a comprehensive and growing learning and development library. You can expect to be carefully performance-managed using our proprietary tools, ensuring that your contributions are fairly measured and that you are supported in your drive to succeed in any areas that need developing.

We offer competitive salaries and the best commission structure in the market. We have a simple and straightforward commission model that rewards you for what you generate. With no caps, your earning potential is unlimited.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development

Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).

Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.

Location: Brazil

The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.

The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.

Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.

Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.

Other Requirements:

  • This role will require occasional in-person travel, which may include Canada, the U.S., Mexico, Colombia, Chile, and/or Peru, and can be primarily performed remotely.

title: Lead Accountant (Brazil) - SQM Iodine & Plant Nutrition
description:
SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition , a global mining and chemical company, has a worldwide leadership position in the markets in which we are present, which is possible thanks to the strategic location of our operations in northern Chile, from where we have access to high-value resources, in addition to our network of commercial offices that allows us to reach more than 100 countries with our products.

Every day we are inspired by our purpose: “we develop unique capabilities that transform resources into life and progress” , achieving the highest quality products that generate value to strategic industries such as health, technology and food.

This is a great opportunity for talented people who can develop as a Accounting Lead for our office in Campinas, Brazil.

YOUR MISSION

Oversee and coordinate the company's administrative and financial activities, ensuring the efficient use of resources, compliance with accounting, tax, and legal obligations, and the generation of reliable information for decision-making. The objective is to guarantee financial stability, operational efficiency, and adequate support for other areas of the organization.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Bank Management

  • Receive, review, and process invoice payments.
  • Monitor cash balances based on the Company's cash flow needs.
  • Prepare bank reconciliations.

Third-Party Management

  • Keep customer and supplier master data up to date.
  • Request third-party assessments through the Compliance platform.

Credit and Commercial Control

Fixed Assets and Leases (IFRS 16)

Payroll Management

General Accounting

  • Provide support for the proper recording of accounting transactions.
  • Validate exchange rate controls on a quarterly basis.
  • Coordinate the closing and opening of accounting periods.
  • Manage accounting structures and taxes.
  • Send the monthly closing schedule to the relevant areas.

Other Routine Activities

  • Monitor and follow up on internal control.
  • Provide administrative support in response to requests from other areas, the Finance Manager, or other corporate management.
  • Analyze and communicate transfer pricing adjustments, when applicable.
  • Request supplier approvals in accordance with compliance criteria.
  • Manage expense reports on the Rydoo platform.
  • Prepare employment certificates.
  • Fill out forms for supplier registration.
  • Follow up on requirements from control entities.
  • Attend to legal procedures that apply to the company.

THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED

  • Graduate in Accounting (Accounting Sciences) – qualification recognized in Brazil (active CRC)
  • Desirable Postgraduate degree in Finance, Taxation, or International Standards (IFRS)
  • Minimum 5 years in accounting roles (general accounting, taxes, financial reporting), preferably in medium or large companies.
  • Languages: Portuguese, English and Spanish.
  • Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Desirable use of Odoo
  • Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS
  • Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures
  • Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable.

WE OFFER:

  • Permanent hiring
  • Working day: Monday to Friday
  • Place of work: Initially, it will be remote work, followed by office work in Campinas, Brazil
  • The opportunity to belong and develop in a dynamic work environment and continuous learning

At SQM Iodine Plant Nutrition we are committed to the Inclusion Law (Law N°21.015) , so we invite you to inform us if you require any adjustment to properly participate in our selection processes.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.

Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.

Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes   Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.
Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

description:

Based on architecture standards set by the headquarters IT architecture team, test and validate local products, drive procurement execution, and complete device purchases.

title: AI Full-Stack Engineer
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The AI Full-Stack Engineer will be responsible for building and maintaining AI applications on top of existing LLM APIs. This role will focus on integration, building robust AI-driven applications, and optimizing their evaluation and performance. The AI Full-Stack Engineer will ensure that our AI applications are developed, configured, and adopted to meet evolving needs, with a strong emphasis on Python-based solutions.

Duties and Responsibilities:

AI Application Development and Integration

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure AI applications leveraging existing LLM APIs.
  • Implement and manage integrations with various AI platforms and services.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises, specifically tailored for AI functionalities.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for AI applications.
  • Monitor and optimize AI application performance and cost, including model evaluation and optimization.
  • Ensure data quality checks for AI models and applications; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.

Python Application Development

  • Utilize Python libraries and frameworks relevant to AI application development.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate AI applications with existing systems.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary conduit among business leads, product managers, and AI/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for AI development.
  • Promote adoption of new AI capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for AI application deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for new AI features.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics for AI applications.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Familiarity with existing LLM APIs and experience building applications on top of them.
  • Experience with integration of AI applications into existing systems.
  • Proficiency in Python and familiarity with AI-specific libraries and frameworks.
  • Experience with optimizing AI model evaluation and performance.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for AI applications.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 2+ years in AI engineering, full-stack development with an AI focus, or related domains within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or similar.

description:
Gambling.com Group (Nasdaq: GAMB) is a multi-award winning provider of marketing and sports data services looking for exceptional talent interested in the fast-paced, high-growth online gambling industry. The company operates a portfolio of renowned websites and brands – including flagship site Gambling.com and sports betting site Bookies.com as well as iGaming-focused sites Casinos.com, BonusFinder.com and UK-centric Freebets.com. In the U.S., the company operates state-specific websites such as NewYorkBets.com, BetCarolina.com, and BetArizona.com, helping consumers discover and connect with legal gambling options.

In addition to its marketing operations, Gambling.com Group provides sports data services through consumer subscription platforms like OddsJam and RotoWire, along with B2B services through OpticOdds. These offerings deliver real-time data, actionable insights, and technology driven tools to both consumers and enterprise partners.

As the first and only online gambling affiliate publicly traded in the U.S., Gambling.com Group has earned recognition as a leader in its field – most recently winning Casino Affiliate of the Year at the 2024 EGR Operator Awards. Gambling.com Group embraces a majority remote-first hybrid work model, offering employees the flexibility to work remotely while being part of a global team. For some roles, in-office presence is required for operational reasons, ensuring seamless collaboration and effectiveness where needed. With flagship offices in Dublin, Charlotte, and Malta, and satellite offices in Madison, Helsinki, Serbia, and Costa Rica, we operate on a "think local, act global" mindset. Gambling.com Group is on the lookout for innovative, solution-driven, and fast-paced thinkers to join our growing team.

Are you ready to take the next step in your career?

At OpticOdds, we’re transforming how companies trade and manage risk in the sports betting industry. We provide real-time sports betting data and risk management solutions that help clients boost profitability while saving thousands of engineering hours. We’ve simplified real-time data and made it more accessible and actionable for sportsbooks, exchanges, and platforms.

Our product is strong. Our traction is real. Now, we’re looking to expand our small, fast-moving team to keep up with explosive growth. That’s where you come in.

As our first Central America Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving OpticOdds’ commercial growth across the region. The focus is on building new business opportunities, developing strategic operator relationships, and expanding accounts over time.

This role requires ownership of the full sales cycle: identifying opportunities, engaging with clients, managing negotiations, and ensuring long-term success with signed operators. Success will come from strong industry connections, sharp commercial instincts, and the ability to represent OpticOdds effectively both at industry events and in direct client engagements.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the full sales cycle with clients, from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop a balanced pipeline by sourcing outbound opportunities and converting inbound leads.
  • Expand OpticOdds’ footprint across Central and South America with a focus on enterprise sportsbooks while also engaging emerging operators.
  • Deliver clear, compelling presentations to clients at all levels of an organization, both in-person and remotely.
  • Listen actively to client needs and translate those into actionable feedback for the product and engineering teams.
  • Monitor regulatory changes, competitor activity, and operator strategies, and use those insights to strengthen OpticOdds’ positioning.
  • Represent OpticOdds at industry events and conferences to build visibility and credibility in the region.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data in the CRM with clear prioritization and forecasting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine messaging, improve collateral, and align commercial strategy with product direction.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience in the sports betting industry.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed aggressive revenue targets.
  • Strong network within sportsbooks and operators in Central and South America.
  • Fluency in Spanish and Portuguese strongly preferred.

title: Gerente de Vendas | Caminhões Sanitários
description:
Descrição da vaga

Você conhece a Sany do Brasil? Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração.

Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias. Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto.

Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países. No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m². Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa. E

m 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril. No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP. A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Gerente de Vendas, você irá:

  • Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de vendas para o portfólio de Caminhões Sanitários;
  • Gerenciar o funil de vendas, desde a prospecção até o fechamento de contratos, assegurando a satisfação do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e novas demandas, analisando concorrência, tendências e potencial de clientes;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos com stakeholders do setor;
  • Realizar visitas técnicas e comerciais, apresentações de produtos e negociação de propostas comerciais;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de engenharia, pós-vendas e operações para garantir soluções técnicas adequadas e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho da área comercial (KPIs), como volume de vendas, margem, rentabilidade e forecast;
  • Participar de feiras, eventos e fóruns do setor portuário e logístico para promover a marca e gerar novos negócios.

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas técnicas, preferencialmente no setor de Caminhões Sanitários;
  • Atuação prévia com negociações complexas (grandes contas, projetos sob medida, contratos de longo prazo);
  • Vivência no relacionamento com clientes B2B e na gestão de ciclo de vendas consultivo;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de CRM e pacote Office.

title: Analista de manutenção
description:
Analista de Manutenção

Sobre a ABN

A Asgaard Bourbon Navegação (ABN) é uma empresa brasileira dedicada à prestação de serviços marítimos para a indústria offshore. Com sede no Rio de Janeiro, atua ao longo da costa brasileira oferecendo soluções eficientes e seguras.

A ABN opera uma frota de embarcações especializadas, como AHTS (Anchor Handling Tug Supply) e OSRV (Oil Spill Response Vessel), preparadas para atender a diversas operações no setor, incluindo abastecimento, reboque, manuseio de âncoras e manutenção de terminais oceânicos.

A empresa se destaca pelo compromisso com a segurança, ética, transparência e respeito às pessoas e ao meio ambiente, contando com uma equipe qualificada e engajada em oferecer excelência nos serviços prestados.

Quais são as responsabilidades da posição?

  • Garantir a atualização dos registros de manutenção nos sistemas corporativos (IFS, SeaPack e outros).
  • Acompanhar a execução das manutenções preventivas e corretivas das embarcações, assegurando o cumprimento dos planos e prazos estabelecidos.

  • Solicitar orçamentos, negociar com prestadores de serviços e acompanhar a execução até o fechamento contratual, assegurando qualidade, prazos e custos.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Suprimentos, Operações e QSMS, garantindo a conformidade com procedimentos internos e normas de segurança.
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho da manutenção e propor melhorias nos processos.
  • Manter a gestão documental e o histórico de manutenções atualizados, conforme padrões internos e requisitos contratuais.

Quais são os requisitos da posição?

  • Nível superior completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Elétrica, Naval ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em manutenção, preferencialmente em empresas de apoio marítimo.
  • Inglês intermediário (leitura e interpretação técnica).
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.

O que seria diferencial para posição?

  • Conhecimento de sistemas de manutenção (IFS, TM Master, AMOS, Unisea, SeaPack ou similares).
  • Atuação prévia em empresas do setor offshore ou estaleiros navais.
  • Experiência em negociação com fornecedores técnicos e prestadores de serviços.
  • Conhecimento de processos de QSMS e auditorias marítimas.

Quais são os nossos benefícios?

title: Tax Sr Analyst (Advanced English)
description:
Join Our Team as Tax Sr Analyst – Brazil (São Paulo) Advanced English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil

Are you a seasoned tax professional ready to lead and make an impact in a global organization? We’re looking for a Tax Sr Analyst to oversee tax compliance and strategic initiatives for our Brazilian entity. What You’ll Do

As Tax Sr Analyst, you’ll be responsible for:

  • Leading tax compliance for direct and indirect taxes in Brazil.

  • Collaborating with external auditors and tax authorities during audits.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years in Brazilian tax (local & international), tax accounting, and compliance.
  • Education: Degree in Accounting or Tax.
  • Technical Skills: SAP, SPED, HFM (BRACS), Blackline.
  • Tax Expertise: IRPJ, CSLL, ISS, PIS, COFINS, ICMS; knowledge of tax treaties and audit processes.
  • Languages: Advanced English required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, analytical mindset, team leadership, and collaboration.

Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a global company with a strong presence in LATAM.
  • Lead impactful tax projects and contribute to strategic decisions.
  • Work in a collaborative and inclusive environment.
  • Grow your career with opportunities for development and innovation.

title: Data Architect
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Data Architect will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining robust data models and SQL-based solutions, with a focus on Google Cloud Platform. This role will ensure data integrity, optimize database performance, and support data-driven initiatives, particularly within the higher education sector.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Data Modelling and SQL Development

  • Design and implement scalable and efficient relational and dimensional data models.
  • Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and functions.
  • Ensure data quality and integrity across various data sources and reporting layers.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Expertise

  • Utilize GCP services such as BigQuery, Cloud SQL, and Dataflow for data storage, processing, and analysis.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data warehouses and data lakes on GCP.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for GCP data environments using tools like Terraform.
  • Monitor and optimize GCP resource performance and cost for data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • “Can-do” attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with relational database design and data modelling.
  • Demonstrable experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) data services (e.g., BigQuery, Cloud SQL, Dataflow).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform.
  • Experience with data quality checks and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience in the higher education space.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools for data platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python for data scripting and automation.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in SQL engineering, data modelling, data engineering, or a related data-centric role, preferably within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Quality and Engineering Specialist
description:
About us:

DTX Aerospace is a leading company in the aerospace industry. Known for its innovative approach and cutting-edge technology, the company specializes in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of Landing Gears. With a strong focus on quality and safety, we have established ourselves as a trusted partner to many major airlines and military organizations worldwide. We are committed to continuous improvement and sustainability, investing heavily in research and development to drive the industry forward.

About the job:

The Specialist in the Quality and Engineering department is a highly experienced professional who takes a leadership role in quality management and technical reference. They are responsible for overseeing and directing high complex quality control processes, leading strategic improvements, and ensuring the company’s adherence to industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Assist to oversee quality control and engineering processes for the landing gear MRO.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive quality improvement programs to enhance operational performance.
  • Technical guidance for analysts, ensuring compliance with internal procedures, manuals and best practices.
  • Perform advanced analysis of data, lead root cause investigations, and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage and ensure compliance with all aerospace regulations, quality certifications (ANAC, FAA, ISO 9001, etc.) and approved technical data (CMMs and other manufacture manuals).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including operations, supply chain and planning to ensure seamless quality management.
  • Support internal and external audits, providing technical support and assistance during regulatory inspections and certifications.
  • Develop and report on key quality performance indicators, identifying areas for process optimization and cost reduction.
  • Be the technical reference in strategic decision-making regarding quality and process improvements.

Work Experience:

+5 Years of experience working in an aeronautical industry with quality and/or engineering.

Strong experience with quality auditing process (aeronautical authorities (FAA, ANAC, EASA), supplier qualification and aeronautical departments).

Educational:

Technical degree or Graduation (Engineering, Quality or Technical) concluded with Post graduation/ master’s degree in concluded.

Advanced / Fluent English is mandatory

Technical Skills:

Advanced quality tools, drawing interpretations (development is a plus), in-depth knowledge of aeronautical authorities’ regulations (FAA, EASA, ANAC) and ISO 9001 standard or related audit standard requirements.

Obs.: Office and shop floor setting in a regulated aerospace maintenance facility.

May require occasional hands-on inspections or shop visits involving PPE and exposure to aircraft components and tooling.

Work may involve tight deadlines and collaboration across departments.

Location:

100% in office position at Rio de Janeiro.

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
Help more patients access life-changing clinical trials by building the team that makes it possible.

About Denali Health

Denali Health is a fast-growing clinical research network focused on quality data, accelerated enrollment, and operational efficiency. The foundation of our work and approach is based on the talented people (heroes) that help

The Role: Talent Acquisition Lead

You’ll lead full-cycle recruiting across site and central teams—PIs, Sub-Is, CRCs, Regulatory/SSU, QA, Site Directors, and central ops. You’ll partner closely with Operations and Study Start-Up to anticipate demand and build pipelines that let us activate sites quickly. You’ll own sourcing strategy, candidate experience, and the data that guides both. You’ll be hands-on with hard-to-fill roles while standing up repeatable systems for scale. 

What You’ll Do

  • Source niche clinical talent (PIs, Sub-Is, CRCs, Regulatory, QA, central ops)
  • Build and execute hiring plans with executive leadership; define role scopes, competencies, and sourcing plan.
  • Develop industry relationships that become a source of high quality referrals
  • Reduce time-to-hire and time-to-site-activation 
  • Own candidate experience end-to-end—fast feedback, transparent timelines, respectful declines.
  • Conduct interviews to assess competence 
  • Coordinate credentialing and GCP/ICH verification steps with QA/Compliance for a smooth start.

You are a Good Fit If You Have:

  • A strong ability to identify and engage talent 
  • 2–5+ years of recruiting in healthcare or clinical research; Even better if you’re a true clinical research recruiter with clinical trial staffing experience.
  • An ability to assess quality of candidates 
  • A strong work ethic 
  • Have an internal drive for quality and excellence

Why Denali Health

  • Top Quartile Compensation
  • Meaningful impact: Your hires help patients access trials sooner.
  • Scale and speed: Launch roles fast; see your work move studies forward.
  • Mentorship & growth: Learn from experienced clinical ops and QA leaders; clear path to Senior TA.
  • Flexible work
  • Benefits that matter
  • Global collaboration: Work with sites across regions; build an international bench.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a video explaining how you would effectively source and assess talent.

Keywords: clinical research recruiter, clinical trial staffing, CRC hiring, investigator recruitment, GCP, ICH, site activation, decentralized clinical trials, healthcare recruiting.

If your experience looks a little different and you think you can add value, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan , a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. title: Freight Account Manager
description:
About Us

At Billor, short for "Bill of Rights," we are building the largest trucking ecosystem in the U.S., dedicated to supporting truck drivers. By combining FinTech, Technology, and Freight Management, we empower drivers to achieve truck ownership and a better quality of life. Our mission is rooted in freedom, responsibility, and efficiency, enabling drivers to maximize productivity and enjoy more time with their families.

About the role

The Account Manager role at Billor is a data-driven person and passionate about customer service. The Account Manager is responsible to help our truck drivers to achieve their goals, while following all the safety and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute the best strategies to maximize revenue per truck, meeting the needs of different driver profiles, using data for the whole process.
  • Negotiate the best rates with Freight Brokers always looking for the most profitable options, seeking competitive rates per mile and total freight.
  • Monitor and monitor the activities of drivers, ensuring the best use of service hours per driver

A VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA é uma empresa líder em assistência técnica rural, especializada no desenvolvimento e capacitação de todo o setor Agro. Nossa equipe é composta por Agrônomos(as), Médicos(as) Veterinários(as), Biólogos, Zootecnistas, Engenheiros(as) de Alimentos, Engenheiros(as) Agrícolas e Técnicos(as) em Eletromecânica, todos(as) com ampla experiência para oferecer suporte técnico e estratégico a produtores, estudantes, administradores e demais profissionais do agronegócio.

Buscamos um(a) Assistente Técnico(a) de Campo para integrar nossa equipe. Este(a) profissional será responsável por prestar assistência técnica e suporte direto aos produtores rurais, atuando como um elo crucial entre o conhecimento técnico especializado da VON HAUSEN CONSULTORIA e as necessidades práticas do campo. O objetivo é resolver desafios, otimizar processos e impulsionar a produtividade agropecuária nas regiões atendidas.

Principais Responsabilidades Diárias

  • Prestar assistência e suporte técnico contínuo diretamente no campo.
  • Realizar atendimento qualificado e proativo ao produtor rural, compreendendo suas demandas e oferecendo soluções.
  • Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas técnicos específicos das atividades agropecuárias.
  • Coletar, analisar e interpretar dados técnicos para subsidiar o desenvolvimento e a implementação de soluções eficazes.
  • Manter uma comunicação clara e eficiente, tanto com a equipe interna quanto com os produtores atendidos, garantindo o fluxo de informações e o acompanhamento das ações.

REQUISITOS INDISPENSÁVEIS PARA A CANDIDATURA

Para esta posição, é fundamental que o(a) candidato(a) atenda aos seguintes critérios mandatórios:

Experiência Comprovada em Assistência Técnica e Suporte de Campo:

  • Mínimo de 6 meses de experiência direta e comprovada na prestação de assistência técnica e suporte em campo.

Experiência em, pelo menos, uma das seguintes áreas do agronegócio:

  • Fruticultura
  • Olericultura
  • Grãos
  • Bovinocultura de Corte
  • Bovinocultura de Leite
  • Ovinocultura
  • Apicultura
  • Agroindústria

Registro Ativo em Conselho de Classe:

Habilitação e Acesso a Veículo para Campo:

  • Possuir CNH (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação) válida , Categoria B ou superior.
  • Ter capacidade e acesso a um veículo para deslocamento em campo (seja veículo próprio, alugado ou emprestado). A empresa não exige a posse de um veículo, mas a disponibilidade e o uso para as atividades do cargo são requisitos essenciais.

Habilidades Analíticas Desenvolvidas:

  • Aptidão comprovada para coletar, analisar e interpretar dados técnicos complexos, transformando informações em soluções práticas e eficazes para os desafios do campo.

Excelência em Comunicação e Atendimento:

DIFERENCIAIS (O que Valorizamos)

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
A CUB é especializada na automatização da gestão de recebíveis e do pós-venda para o setor imobiliário. Nossa tecnologia aumenta a eficiência, reduz a inadimplência, otimiza custos operacionais e oferece insights estratégicos para decisões mais rápidas e precisas.

O que você vai fazer

- Desenhar pipelines end-to-end (ingestão → modelagem → serving) com testes e observabilidade.

- Modelar com dbt (models, tests, snapshots, docs) e manter camadas bronze/silver/gold

- Operar e evoluir a orquestração (Dagster; experiência com Airflow/Prefect é bem-vinda).

- Otimizar custo/performance e garantir governança (contratos de dados, lineage, CI/CD).

- Entregar marts e métricas para times de negócio e dashboards no Metabase.

- Escrever design docs, revisar PRs e mentorar o time.

Stack

- DW/Lakehouse: Snowflake (ok ter vindo de BigQuery/Redshift/Databricks)

- Transformação: dbt & python

- Orquestração: Dagster (ou Airflow/Prefect)

- Ingestão: Airbyte, AWS DMS e scripts internos

- Linguagens & BI: SQL avançado, Python (numpy/pandas), Metabase

- Infra/DevEx: Git/GitHub, CI/CD, cloud (AWS/GCP)

Requisitos

- Experiência construindo pipelines de dados em produção.

- dbt em produção com boas práticas (tests/snapshots/docs).

- Orquestração (schedules, backfills, alertas) e governança aplicada.

- Domínio de SQL e uso de Python para automação/manipulação.

- Inglês para leitura técnica.

Modelo de trabalho

Remoto em tempo integral

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Supervisor de Controle de Qualidade
description:

  • Experiência com gestão na área de Controle de Qualidade em indústria farmacêutica;
